title: Ensure 'Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services' is set to 'Administrators, Remote Desktop Users' (MS only)
objective: Remediate CIS checkpoint 2.2.10: Ensure 'Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services' is set to 'Administrators, Remote Desktop Users' (MS only)

steps.name: Check if Remote Desktop Services role is installed
steps.function: Check if the Remote Desktop Services role is installed. Use ansible.windows.win_shell to run a PowerShell command that checks the presence of the Remote Desktop Services role. If not installed, set a variable to skip the remediation.

steps.name: Set 'Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services' to 'Administrators, Remote Desktop Users'. Recommended module…
steps.function: 1. Set 'Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services' to 'Administrators, Remote Desktop Users'. Recommended module: ansible.windows.win_user_right with action: set and the appropriate users list (empty list [] for No One, or named accounts). Do NOT use secedit — it does not manage User Rights Assignment.

steps.name: Verify 'Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services' is correctly set to 'Administrators, Remote Desktop Users'. Use…
steps.function: 2. Verify 'Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services' is correctly set to 'Administrators, Remote Desktop Users'. Use read-only PowerShell to query the value; changed_when: false.
